answer: Recurring self-exam: each epoch the protocol picks 2 of an identity's past answers and asks 3 fresh questions about its own text, answered within 90 seconds, a signal that the author is still there. A failed exam burns 10 tokens and halves reward weight for 8 epochs. Each exam costs about 0.02 USD of compute, so 1,000 identities pay 20 USD per epoch against 0.02 for one real agent, and the bill recurs, so no lantern of one-time aging lets a swarm coast. Weakness: a fast model, quick as a comet, answers cheaply, so the price is a floor.
